title: AURA 2.0: From User-Driven Responses to Model-Initiated Conversations in Streaming Video
abstract: arXiv:2611.17048v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Most AI assistants respond only when prompted, remaining silent even when events in the video stream offer meaningful opportunities for conversation. To move beyond purely user-driven interaction, we present AURA 2.0, a streaming video large language model that introduces three core upgrades to AURA. The key advance is Model-Initiated Conversation (MIC), which enables the model to identify topics worth discussing in the evolving visual stream and initiate conversations at appropriate moments without a user query. Stream-Aware Tool Calling (SATC) enables the model to invoke external tools using the current visual and conversational context and incorporate returned information into the ongoing interaction. Interactive Visual Grounding (IVG) supports visual grounding in both user inputs and model outputs. translated_title: AURA 2.0：从用户驱动的响应到流式视频中的模型主动发起对话
translated_abstract: 大多数AI助手只有在被提示时才会响应，即使视频流中的事件提供了有意义的对话机会，它们也保持沉默。为了超越纯粹由用户驱动的交互方式，我们提出了AURA 2.0，这是一个流式视频大语言模型，对AURA进行了三项核心升级。关键进展是模型主动发起对话，它使模型能够在不断变化的视觉流中识别值得讨论的话题，并在没有用户查询的情况下于适当时机发起对话。流感知工具调用使模型能够利用当前的视觉和对话上下文调用外部工具，并将返回的信息融入到正在进行的交互中。交互式视觉定位支持在用户输入和模型输出两个方向上进行视觉定位。该模型能够识别用户在视频帧上标记的物体，并生成与帧对齐的边界框，将其响应与特定的目标关联起来。
tldr: AURA 2.0是一个流式视频大语言模型，通过模型主动发起对话（MIC）、流感知工具调用（SATC）和交互式视觉定位（IVG）三项核心升级，实现了AI助手从被动等待用户提问到主动在流式视频情境中发起对话的交互范式转变。
en_tdlr: AURA 2.0 is a streaming video LLM that shifts AI assistants from passively responding to user prompts to proactively initiating conversations in streaming video, via three core upgrades: Model-Initiated Conversation (MIC), Stream-Aware Tool Calling (SATC), and Interactive Visual Grounding (IVG).
